beats.name: The stack
beats.blurb: The gang looks up at a massive stack of paper: THE RULES. Are the rules working?

beats.name: The window
beats.blurb: "Let's look out the window." Outside: the street the missing tax should have paid for. Kai, 2026-11-10: lots of homeless people, the consequence of the tax-haven rule.

beats.name: Tear it up
beats.blurb: Back inside, the gang tears up the rules.
